# hvrg_page_view (Resource)

The page_view records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `page_id` (String) the page the view is placed on
- `view_id` (String) the placed view

### Optional

- `columns` (Dynamic) column selection of a records view on this placement
- `config` (Dynamic) per placement configuration, annotations.hidden and nothing else
- `layout` (Dynamic) grid position and size: x, y, w, h
- `status` (String) draft until saved, active when it renders, erroneous when its view failed
- `style` (String) CSS applied to the placement
